name: optuna-search-demo
notes: OptunaSearch (dskit/pipeline/libs/optuna.py, docs/25 §2 row 5) driving the docs/24 §8 search seam over the synthetic market: a seeded TPE study tunes clip.lo against the val-split score, the driver re-executes the dirty subgraph per trial via ctx.rerun, and the winner is re-applied so report consumes the tuned pass. Every `uses` is an import reference, so this document runs against the bare toolkit with zero registrations: python -m dskit.pipeline run examples/pipeline/optuna-search.json --asof 2026-01-01. The space here is the categorical (list) form, right when the knob has a handful of meaningful settings; when it is genuinely continuous, declare a {low, high} range spec instead — optuna-continuous.json is this document's twin, differing only in its `name` and that shape — an agreement PINNED by tests/pipeline_libs/test_optuna.py, not merely asserted in these notes.

clip.notes: clip.lo is the knob the search tunes — overrides address EXISTING params only

validate.notes: the objective's source: a score node reading 'val' — selection never sees test (spec §8)

search.notes: 6 seeded TPE trials over 3 choices — revisits re-execute deterministically; same seed = same trial sequence

report.notes: downstream of the search: consumes the winner pass
